card.name: Final nouns ending short drug label phrases
card.fires_on: Nouns or word parts that finish a short noun phrase, such as 'pen' after 'prefilled', 'number' after 'digit', or 'sheet' in 'temporary sheet of water'. Also fires partway through longer words like nitroglycerin and nucleoside.

modes.description: Fires on a concrete noun that completes a phrase, such as pen, inhaler, number, or sheet.
